strNotes: Grow potatoes and lettuce, cook potato portions and manage irrigation with Verdemorrow equipment. Add W2 pipes for up to eight racks, R3 water storage or B2 nutrient recovery as needed. Crew orders can help with routine work. Requires Phobos Framework; Shipbreaker controls and Valtora's Ship's Water integration are optional. See the installation guide for current requirements. Short growth cycles and simplified chemistry are gameplay choices. Development candidate; in-game evaluation pending.
